data.name: 311 Requests
data.description:
Listing of all requests raised to 311, details of each call/transaction and update on the status.

This is anonymized data intended for reporting on trends; if you have a specific reference number for which you would like to check the status, please see the "check your status" search box at https://www.edmonton.ca/programs_services/311-city-services.

Due to the volume of data, this dataset contains 311 requests created within the current calendar year and the previous two calendar years.  In January of a given year it will contain 2 years and 1 month of requests; in December of that year it will contain 3 years of requests. For historical data please search for "311 Requests (YEAR)" where "YEAR" is a year value, e.g. 2018. These will exist for years that no longer exist in this dataset, i.e. "current year minus three" will be the greatest year value that has its own single-year dataset.

General Information.Purpose: To share 311 Ticket Information with the public and to use the data for some basic reporting for the public to refer to.

columns.name: Row ID
columns.description: System generated value for each 311 request created in the system

columns.name: Date Closed
columns.description: The date the appropriate City department has investigated the concern and identified steps to resolve your request. Action for resolving the issue may be dependent on priority and weather conditions or your issue has been closed due to lack of information including contact details.

columns.name: Date Created
columns.description: The date the service request ticket was created

columns.name: Year
columns.description: The Year in which the 311 ticket was created.

columns.name: Month Number
columns.description: The numeric Month in which the 311 ticket was created.

columns.name: Month
columns.description: The Month in which the 311 ticket was created.

columns.name: Request Status
columns.description: The stage at which your request is at, Open or Closed.

columns.name: Status Detail
columns.description: Certain request types may include additional details describing the progress or action associated with the request. The state of progress the request is at.

columns.name: Service Category
columns.description: The type of action or service request.

columns.name: Service Description
columns.description: Provides a general description of the service request.

columns.name: Interaction Channel
columns.description: The channel or method in which the request was initiated

columns.name: Service Area
columns.description: The business area that is responsible for the service.

columns.name: Referral Type
columns.description: The action associated with  how the request was handled either information provided or transferred to a business area.

columns.name: Neighbourhood ID
columns.description: Unique number identifier given to Neighbourhoods throughout Edmonton

columns.name: Neighbourhood
columns.description: The name given to a Neighbourhood

columns.name: Ward
columns.description: A unique number give to a geographical area representing a electoral area

columns.name: Service Category (Service Area)
columns.description: A combination of Service Category and Service Area so visualizations can be created

columns.name: (Service Area) Service Category
columns.description: A combination of Service Area and Service Category so visualizations can be created

columns.name: (Service Area) Service Description
columns.description: A combination of Service Area and Service Description so visualizations can be created

columns.name: Nbhd Latitude
columns.description: The latitude value for the centroid of the Neighbourbhood

columns.name: Nbhd Longitude
columns.description: The longitude value for the centroid of the Neighbourhood

columns.name: Nbhd Location
columns.description: The combination of latitude/longitude for the centroid of the Neighbourhood used for mapping purposes.

columns.name: Ward Latitude
columns.description: The latitude value for the centroid of the Ward

columns.name: Ward Longitude
columns.description: The longitude value for the centroid of the Ward

columns.name: Ward Location
columns.description: The combination of latitude/longitude for the centroid of the Ward used for mapping purposes.

columns.name: Count
columns.description: A field created to do a sum function for charting purposes (Note: having this would be equivalent to doing a row count).
